subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should ClawHub stop after the documented shared-route extraction no-go, or sponsor a different, explicitly bounded bundle-reduction hypothesis?
rationale: The evidence rules out the proposed first extraction but does not establish which larger architectural change, if any, is worth its SSR and navigation complexity.

options.title: Park the no-go investigation
options.body: Record that the tested extraction did not reduce the route preload closure and avoid further refactoring without new evidence.

options.title: Sponsor one replacement experiment
options.body: Choose a named import boundary and measurable reduction target before authorizing another focused A/B.

recommendation.title: Park the no-go investigation
recommendation.body: Record that the tested extraction did not reduce the route preload closure and avoid further refactoring without new evidence.
